releases.title: Go+HTMX production comparison, AI Pulse & automated deploys

changes.text: Shipped a full Go+HTMX implementation as a parallel production site on my own Hetzner VPS (SQLite database, Caddy, systemd) – identical content, dashboard, and AI bouncer to the Next.js version.
Tech Switcher and Live Performance widget: switch between the two implementations and see the response-time comparison measured live from your own browser against both servers.
AI Pulse dashboard section (Hacker News trends, trending GitHub repos, stock prices) on both stacks, with its own data pipeline on the Go side.
The Next.js comparison build moved to its own domain (next.karotammela.fi) on Vercel; karotammela.fi is now the default Go+HTMX implementation.
Automated deploy pipeline via GitHub Actions: tests, build, and deploy to the Hetzner server run automatically on every push.
New blog post covering the reasoning behind the Go+HTMX build, the VPS setup, and the SQLite experience.
The homepage intro now briefly explains the two-stack comparison and where to find the switcher.
Added Hy3 to the favorite language models list (H2/2026).
Integrated Swamp automation platform for project management and workflow automation.
Automated Vercel production log monitoring: a new Swamp extension that periodically inspects deployment logs for errors and dispatches alerts via Resend.
GitHub Actions workflow configured to run the monitor automatically every hour.
Three brand new custom postcard templates: Ystävänpäiväkortti, Kaljakortti, and Apinakortti with tuned typography and positions.
Multi-layered delivery security: integrated advanced client behavior validation, automated link scrubbing, and adaptive recipient-protection rate limiting.
Removed three legacy holiday postcard templates.
A brand new interactive digital postcard customizer utilizing HTML5 Canvas for real-time preview, supporting local PNG download or emailing via Resend SDK.
Three clean, lightweight holiday card templates (Winter Warmth, Summer Sunset, and Elegant Minimalist).
Automated query parameter checking (?name= and ?email=) to prefill customized postcard forms.
GitHub Trending AI/ML repositories panel showing daily hot repos, starring metrics, and Gemini-translated summaries.
Hacker News freshness algorithm: implemented 7-day rolling deduplication and a stepwise date window search to guarantee daily freshness.
Upgraded deprecated Gemini 3.1 preview models to the latest stable gemini-3.1-flash-lite.
AI Pulse tab in the dashboard showing daily top AI stories from Hacker News, each summarised by Gemini in both English and Finnish.
Interactive 1-year stock price chart for 12 AI companies (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMD, ARM, AVGO, CRWV, PLTR, AI, SNOW, SOUN) with a company name selector and gradient area chart.
Vercel Cron job running daily at 08:00 UTC to refresh trends and stock data automatically.
Two new Turso tables: ai_trends and ai_stocks, with Drizzle migrations and upsert-safe query functions.
Stock chart axis labels now use a hardcoded colour to stay visible on dark backgrounds.
Dashboard Changelog tab with a curated, bilingual release history and coloured type pills.
Availability and social links panel next to the Overview contact form on wide screens.
Inline GitHub and LinkedIn brand icons so the companion panel does not depend on brand icons in lucide-react.
Overview contact section now uses a two-column layout on large screens and stacks cleanly on mobile.
Dashboard view query widened so ?view=changelog is preserved on reloads and deep links.
Custom SVG favicon across all routes.
Refreshed README to match current scope, security notes and ignored files.
Share button navigator type narrowing under strict TypeScript.
Cleared out the committed .env.example to avoid stale guidance.
